```{r}
library(edm)
library(lhm)
library(om)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
dat <- lhm::bshio

lhdat           <- lhm(ainf = 30, iter = 100)
nmort(lhdat)    <- list(mu = dat$natural_mortality[,"Female"])
size(lhdat)     <- list(mu = lapply(dat$vbgrowth, function(x) x[1]))
mass(lhdat)     <- list(mu = dat$mass)

# logistic maturity from length at 50% mature
x <- size(lhdat)
ff <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x + dat$maturity$lmat))

maturity(lhdat) <- as.vector(apply(x, 2, ff))

sr(lhdat)       <- list(type = 'BH', mu = 0.75, cv = 0.1)
```

```{r}
# base case
rCalc(lhdat)@lognormal_par$`E[r]`

# with correct fecundity
lhdat@lhdat[['fecundity']] <- matrix(t(apply(size(lhdat), 1, function(x) { y <- -91.97 + 0.6052 * x; y[y < 0] <- 0; y})), ncol = lhdat@iter)
lhdat <- alphaCalc(lhdat)
lhdat <- rhoCalc(lhdat)

(r_base <- rCalc(lhdat)@lognormal_par$`E[r]`)
```

# Simulations
```{r}
# default population dynamics function
# (should accept single monte-carlo sample only)
bsh_pdyn <- function(B0, harvest, time, selectivity, maturity, mass, fecundity, size, h, M, tmax, ages) {
    
    nage <- length(ages)
    n    <- array(dim = c(nage, tmax))
    bmat <- vector("numeric", length = tmax)
    bfec <- vector("numeric", length = tmax)
    bexp <- vector("numeric", length = tmax)
    hr   <- vector("numeric", length = tmax)
    p    <- vector("numeric", length = nage)
    
    trim <- function(x) min(max(x, 0), 1)
    
    # set up equilibrium population
    p[1] <- 1
    for(a in 2:nage)
        p[a] <- p[a-1]*exp(-M[a-1])
    p[nage] <- p[nage]/(1-exp(-M[nage]))
    rho <- sum(p * maturity * fecundity)
    R0 <- B0 / rho
    n[,1] <- R0 * p
    bmat[1] <- sum(n[,1] * maturity * mass)
    bfec[1] <- sum(n[,1] * maturity * fecundity)
    bexp[1] <- sum(n[,1] * selectivity * mass)
    hr[1]   <- trim(harvest[1] / bexp[1])
    
    # set up S-R parameters
    alp <- (4 * h * R0) / (B0 * (1 - h))
    bet <- (5 * h - 1)  / (B0 * (1 - h))
    
    for(y in 2:tmax) {
        
        n[1,y] <- alp * bfec[y-1]/(bet + bfec[y-1])
        #n[1,y] <- n[1,y] * srr[y]
        for(a in 2:nage)
            n[a,y] <- n[a-1,y-1]*exp(-M[a-1])*(1-selectivity[a-1]*hr[y-1])
        n[nage,y] <- n[nage,y] + n[nage,y-1]*exp(-M[a-1])*(1-selectivity[nage]*hr[y-1])
        bexp[y] <- sum(n[,y] * selectivity * mass)
        hr[y]   <- trim(harvest[y] / bexp[y])
        bexp[y] <- harvest[y] / hr[y]
        bmat[y] <- sum(n[,y] * maturity * mass)
        bfec[y] <- sum(n[,y] * maturity * fecundity)
    }
    
    # retun numbers at age
    return(array(n, dim = dim(n), dimnames = list(age = ages, time = time)))
}

```


```{r}

#rm(dat)

om_object <- om(pdyn_function = bsh_pdyn, iter = lhdat@iter)

om_object <- load_empirical_data(om_object, edm::bshio[[1]])
om_object <- load_lh_data(om_object, lhdat)
om_object <- load_B0(om_object, 9e5)

ff <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x + 150))
om_object <- load_selectivity(om_object, apply(om_object@lh_data$size, 2, ff))

om_object <- pdyn(om_object)

boxplot(value ~ time, reshape2::melt(biomass(om_object)$mature), na.action = na.pass, outline = FALSE, ylim = range(c(0, biomass(om_object)$total)))
```

```{r}
om_object <- index(om_object, stochastic = FALSE)
dfr_det   <- reshape2::melt(om_object)

boxplot(value ~ time, subset(dfr_det, index == 1), na.action = na.pass, border = 4, outline = FALSE, ylim = range(om_object@empirical_data$index[,1], na.rm = TRUE))
points(om_object@empirical_data$index[,1], col = 2, pch = 19, type = 'b')
```
